d:
Is sal ki shuruaat men gold ne aisi raftar pakri thi ki iske do lakh rupye par pahunchne ke anuman lagae jane lage the. lekin samay bitne ke sath duniya bhar men kaee aisa ghatnakram hue jisse gold ki kimton men giravat ka daur shuru huaa.
Tyoharon aur shadi vivah ke sijan ke samay bharat men gold ki kharidari barh jati hai. aise men log janna chah rahe hain ki kya ye gold kharidne ka sahi samay hai ya iski kimten aur niche jaengi? gold se jure aise hi savalon ke javab talashenge is bar paisa vasul men esaemsi global sikyoritiz men kamoditi risarch hed vandna bharti se.
Prejentar- upasna
